finding: Provider credentials already shared across modalities by tenant/environment/provider. The form incorrectly presented saved secrets as still required and did not explain reuse.

behavior.blank_secret: reuse the existing provider credential in the same tenant/environment; model and parameters remain modality-specific
behavior.new_secret: existing behavior updates the shared provider credential, including when connection testing persists a new credential; not a per-modality override
behavior.ui: saved-credential hint, no required star for saved secrets, empty actual input, explicit shared-update hint when entering a new secret; disable connection fields during scope loads
behavior.api: has_credentials indicates stored secret presence only; no key validity/model access claim, no plaintext or sealed credential returned
behavior.scope: no schema or grant changes; no new credential hierarchy

credential response includes status without plaintext/sealed data
